title: Maestro Onboarding State
description: Persisted by the maestro-onboarding skill. Written as soon as the owner gives their name, then updated as the interview advances. The `status` field gates the CLAUDE.md session state machine: anything other than "complete" means onboarding must be resumed, not skipped. Presence alone is not completion — an abandoned interview leaves this file behind with status "in_progress".

status.description: Whether the interview finished. "in_progress" is written at the first turn and must cause onboarding to resume on the next session.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of onboarding completion. Present only when status is "complete".

track.description: Which onboarding track was taken. Mirrors identity.json.track for the two guided tracks. "imported-brain" is the path taken when the owner already has a structured second brain. Unset until the owner picks a path.

version.description: Content of the VERSION file at the moment of the first write (e.g., "0.1.10").
